entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnet test` with `--framework` is broken on solution with `Microsoft.Testing.Platform` #51030
  • `dotnet new <sometemplate>` suggests deprecated `dotnet new install` syntax #51029
  • [dotnet-sdk-10.0.100-rc.2.25474.116] BilibiliLiveRecordDownLoader build failed with error: Operator '.' cannot be applied to operand of type 'void'. #51023
  • [dotnet-sdk-10.0.100-rc.2.25474.116] grandnode2 build get error: The call is ambiguous between the following methods or properties: 'JsonSerializer.Deserialize<TValue>(ReadOnlySpan<byte>, JsonSerializerOptions?)'... #51022

Closed

  • Update `dotnet test --help` for VSTest to explicitly mention it's VSTest and point out to MTP documentation #50670
  • Test run summary should be localized #50959
  • [NETSDKE2E]Wrong string happens on NET 10 RC2 runtime installer UI. #51018

PullRequests

Created

  • Allow hot reload refresh script injection for 404 status code #51027
    Area-AspNetCore, Area-Watch
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.1xx' #51026
  • Add .webmanifest MIME type mapping to Blazor WASM web.config template #51025
  • Run test template tests with Arcade #51020
  • Skip failure test cases due to GenerateBundle issue #51019
  • Skip failure test cases due to GenerateBundle issue #51017
  • Fix API diff tool crash when no attribute exclusion files are specified #51013

Merged

  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50901
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50998
    Area-CodeFlow
  • Improve where file-level directives are added #50956
    Servicing-approved, Area-run-file
  • dotnet SIGTERM signal handler registration #50983
    Area-CLI
  • [release/9.0.3xx] Make duplicate deb/rpm packages so we can sign them with the new PMC key #50910
    Branch Lockdown
  • Allow SDKs to overwrite default file-based app properties #51004
    Area-run-file
  • Update analyzer redirecting VS extension #50496
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Misc Json PostAction fixes #50977
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2802347 #51014
  • dotnet test for MTP: localize test summary + update command description #50975
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2801306 #50974

Updated

  • [release/10.0.1xx-rc2] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50999
  • [dotnet-watch] Notify DCP of terminated session when process exits on its own #50992
    Area-Watch, 10.0.1xx
  • Enable hot reloading for Blazor inside an iframe #51006
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50946
  • [Proposal] Analyzer test readability/performance improvements #50342
